title: Asymptotics for a continuous-time risk model with multivariate strongly regularly varying claims and stochastic investment returns
abstract: arXiv:2611.18681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper we study the finite-time asymptotic behavior of the entrance probability of the discounted aggregate claims into an extreme region in a multidimensional risk model. Our non-standard risk model is not restricted to the Levy-Renewal framework, that represents a usual assumption for the stochastic returns and the counting process of the claim vectors, respectively. For the modeling of the distribution of claim vectors, we introduce the notion of set-based multivariate (strongly) regularly varying distributions. For the new set-based classes we provide certain closure properties and some examples to show the difference from the usual definitions of multivariate regularly varying distributions. This set-based framework provides a broad and flexible framework to the actuarial applications, and facilitates the modeling of dependence among the claim vectors that arrive at different time epochs. translated_title: 具有多元强正则变化索赔与随机投资收益的连续时间风险模型的渐近性
translated_abstract: 本文研究多维风险模型中折现总索赔进入极端区域概率的有限时间渐近行为。我们的非标准风险模型不受Levy-Renewal框架的限制，而该框架通常是针对随机收益和索赔向量计数过程的常见假设。为了对索赔向量的分布进行建模，我们引入了基于集合的多元（强）正则变化分布的概念。针对这一新的基于集合的类别，我们提供了若干封闭性质和一些例子，以展示其与通常的多元正则变化分布定义的区别。这一基于集合的框架为精算应用提供了广泛而灵活的框架，并便于对在不同时间点到达的索赔向量之间的依赖关系进行建模。本文的两个主要结果建立了……
tldr: 本文提出基于集合的多元强正则变化分布的新概念，在不受Levy-Renewal框架限制的多维风险模型中研究折现总索赔进入极端区域概率的有限时间渐近行为，并能灵活刻画不同时间点索赔向量间的依赖性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces set-based multivariate strongly regularly varying distributions to study the finite-time asymptotics of extreme entrance probabilities in a multidimensional risk model free from the Levy-Renewal framework, flexibly capturing dependence among claims arriving at different time epochs.
